notes.title: Small patch note 1.0.1
notes.content:
-Fixed some minor issues
-Fixed Windowed mode in the option menu
-Fixed audio volume level on the S.T.A.L.K.E.R enemy
-Fixed interactions volume of pills (both and their effect).
-Added indicator "You swallowed the Red Pill" on interaction.
-Added indicator "You swallowed the Blue Pill" on interaction.
-Added indicator "This door is LOCKED" to locked doors to avoid confusion.
-Added indicator "This cabinet is LOCKED" to locked doors to avoid confusion.
-Lowered the flashlights brightness. (Will continue to look into the optimal brightness for the players in case its too bright or too dull.)
-Nerf to V.A.L.K enemy types.
-Added more help and warnings.
-Fixed a problem with the Safe lock HUD.
-Buffs to flashlight.

and Thank you all for reporting bugs and giving suggestions to our email: 
ice9bbstudios@gmail.com
